author: anon-df5e95db
content:
Build a comprehensive differential test suite that reads BAM/SAM files with both noodles-bam and htslib (via our existing Rust bindings), comparing every observable field to validate noodles as a potential replacement for the htslib I/O layer.

## Why
Issue #65 (evaluate BGZF/noodles crate) is the critical gate for the entire BAM Rust migration (blocks #66-#73). This test suite answers that question with data: if noodles produces identical results to htslib on our real test files and edge cases, we can confidently adopt it for the I/O stack.

## Test categories

### 1. Record-level field equivalence
Read every record from test BAMs with both libraries, compare:
- pos, tid, mapq, flags, insert_size, mtid, mpos
- CIGAR (op-by-op)
- sequence (base-by-base)
- quality scores
- qname

### 2. Aux tag equivalence
For every record, iterate all aux tags and compare:
- Tag names match
- Types match (i8/i16/i32/u8/u16/u32/float/double/string/array)
- Values match (including edge cases: missing, empty strings, large arrays)

### 3. Header equivalence
- Same contig names, same order, same lengths
- Same sample names, same order
- Same @RG, @PG records
- name2tid roundtrips produce same IDs

### 4. Index query equivalence
- Same region query → same set of records returned
- Virtual offsets agree (critical for BAI/CSI interop)

### 5. Edge cases
- Unmapped reads (flag 0x4, tid=-1)
- Supplementary/secondary alignments
- Long CIGARs (>65535 ops, CG:B:I encoding)
- All aux tag types including arrays
- Empty sequences, zero-length CIGARs
- Multi-threaded BGZF reading (if noodles supports it)

### 6. Performance comparison
- Wall-clock time reading a large BAM (millions of records)
- Memory usage (peak RSS)
- Throughput with/without threading

## Implementation
- Add noodles-bam, noodles-sam, noodles-bgzf as dev-dependencies
- Test module in a new file (e.g., tests/noodles_comparison.rs) to keep it out of lib
- Use our existing test BAM/SAM/CRAM files
- Property: for every record R, htslib_fields(R) == noodles_fields(R)

## What this resolves
This provides the data to decide #65 and unblock the entire Phase 3-5 BAM migration pipeline (#66-#73). If noodles passes all tests, we adopt it. If it fails specific cases, we document the gaps and decide whether to work around them or contribute upstream fixes.
